paragraphs: I'm applying for the Migration Data Analytics Associate role in Chicago. I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm drawn to this role because it is about making high-stakes program decisions on data people can trust, with clear definitions and checks behind every number.

At Lenovo I documented business requirements and turned stakeholder needs into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20%, and I owned the mapping and QA for AI-powered dashboards that cut reporting time by 4+ hours a week. At Thomson Reuters I ran financial reconciliation with 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting. At JPMorgan Asset Management I built analytics frameworks to track campaign KPIs and turned large datasets into executive reporting.

That fits the work of collecting and validating inputs from product, operations and technology teams, documenting assumptions, and building reporting that leaders can act on. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and worked at JPMorgan Asset Management before school. I'm applying for the Migration Data Analytics Associate role in Chicago. At Lenovo I turned stakeholder requirements into dashboards that improved campaign ROI by 20% and owned QA on AI-powered reporting. I'd like to learn how the team supports migration decisions. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
